entries.source_jp:
事態の打開を図るため禊の神殿屋外
セラー湖の畔で待つレオに会いに行く
entries.source_en:
To try to resolve the current situation,
meet with Leo who is waiting outside
the Temple of Purification near the banks
of Lake Cera.
entries.text:
Um einen Ausweg zu finden,
triff dich mit Leo.
Er wartet draußen am Tempel der Läuterung,
am Ufer des Cera-Sees.

entries.source_jp: メイリーフの家でロイグから話を聞く
entries.source_en: Hear what Loeg has to say in Mayleaf's home
entries.text: Hör dir an, was Loeg in Mayleafs Haus zu sagen hat.

entries.source_jp: レオの待つ禊の神殿屋外セラー湖の畔へ向かう
entries.source_en: Go to Leo waiting by the Temple by the banks of Lake Cera
entries.text: Geh zu Leo am Tempel der Läuterung am Cera-See.

entries.source_jp: レオから竜力の淀みに立ち入る方法を確認する
entries.source_en: Confirm with Leo on how to unlock the stagnant Dragon Force
entries.text: Frag Leo, wie du zur angestauten Drachenkraft gelangst.

entries.source_jp: ポーン郷にある異界の狭間・深層へ向かう
entries.source_en: Head to the Rift's Inner Depths in the Pawn Cathedral
entries.text: Begib dich in die Tiefen des Rifts in der Vasallenkathedrale.

entries.source_jp: 集めた竜の泪をレオに届ける
entries.source_en: Give Leo the Dragon's Tears you have gathered

entries.source_jp: 謁見の間のジョゼフに報告する
entries.source_en: Report to Joseph in the Audience Chamber
Search for the second Dragon Tear
Search for the third Dragon Tear
Search for the fourth Dragon Tear
Search for the fifth Dragon Tear

entries.source_jp: 行く手を阻む敵を殲滅する
entries.source_en: Eliminate any foes that block your path
entries.text: Besiege die Gegner, die dir den Weg versperren.
